verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a many-items-at-once action is the official MCP integration's ability to broadcast the same text to multiple team members. List and filter endpoints are reads, not bulk mutations, and the 10 requests/second per-key limit implies per-item calls otherwise. missing for 10: bulk create/update/delete endpoints for contacts or messages, documented batch API semantics (batch size limits, partial-failure handling), bulk operations beyond messaging team members, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Send a text to one person or broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace.
